faqs.question: Does the product have an auto nozzle check and clean function?
faqs.answer:
Yes, the product has an auto nozzle check function. This function automatically detects clogged nozzles and performs print head cleaning or prints by using normal nozzles to compensate for clogged nozzles. See your product's
User Guide
for instructions.

faqs.question: Which type of ink does the product use?
faqs.answer: The product uses Epson UltraChrome D6r-S dye-based ink.

faqs.question: Is ink included in the box with the product?
faqs.answer: No, ink in not included. You will need to purchase a set of ink packs when you purchase the product.

faqs.question: Can the product print 4-sided borderless prints?
faqs.answer: Yes, 4-sided borderless prints are supported. Supported widths are 3.5", 4", 5", 6", and 8". For custom paper sizes, make sure you select a supported page width for borderless prints.
